# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and rendering updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 will add rendering, platform, performance, and data-safety improvements. The next release targets Uno Platform 7, modern native toolchains, Android display synchronization, and more efficient managed image and text processing.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Uno, Apple, Windows, and WebGPU support updated** — Adds Uno Platform 7 support, raises Apple deployment minimums, aligns Windows native dependencies with current MAUI releases, and packages WebGPU support in the static native library. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377), [#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Bug Fixes

- **CString conversion no longer reads past native buffers** — Creates SKData directly from the native string data without a buffer over-read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention to release data when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image and text processing reduce managed overhead** — Optimizes managed pixel copies, pools HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding buffers, and avoids unnecessary native feature-string allocation during decoding. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
